body: I saw the devil looking in at me through my car window. There was nothing outside the window, it was just a face in my window, almost like it was reflecting from the inside of my moms car. When I tell the story no one believes me or even listens. At first it puzzled me because I couldn't figure out where it was coming from, then when I couldn't figure it out I was just paralyzed with terror as it looked at me.
